description:
Hushfacebook v0.15.0 targets Facebook 583.0.0.39.55 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

Most of this release comes from your requests. A video you tap in the feed can open on its own now, so a swipe up doesn't drop you into an endless reels feed, and the comment sheet can open at full height or from a double tap on a reel. There are new switches to hide the status bar, the Messenger button, the counts under posts and reels, reaction previews and the people row in the share sheet. Settings come in Simplified Chinese, new ones carry a small dot, and Remember what you watch keeps a list so a reel that vanished on refresh is easy to find again. On the fix side, Tap the bar to seek works on 583 again and stories you finish stay watched with View stories anonymously on.

This release has 93 patches. Built by GitHub Actions from commit 3a8bb3577825, with build provenance attested. The patches weren't applied to a Facebook APK in CI.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 583.0.0.39.55, build 475614366, or its 32-bit build 475614365. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
